result.summary: A dark-themed chat interface displays an open approval-mode dropdown above a message composer. The dropdown offers four agent approval options, with 'Manual Approval' currently selected. The composer contains placeholder text about development work and a bottom control row with approval, agent, model, voice, and send controls.
